title: Ok not Great
text: Ok not Great. Decent hampers but cheap plastic used for the wheels. Be nice if the wheels were a little more heavy duty and larger. Can't even see the wheels in the picture hardly. Wheels are too small to be helpful on stairs. Longevity is to be determined on the wheels and the extending handle, they both seem a little frail. Probably not worth the steep price of $50.00 for 3, a reasonable price would be $25 to $30.
